## Just Say Which API You Need. Zenfox Does the Rest.

With Zenfox, you just ask. Say the name of the API, describe what you need it to do, or send your API documentation — Zenfox finds the API, generates the schema, securely stores your credentials with AES-256 encryption via Infisical, and connects everything automatically.

you › Connect me to the Stripe API. I need to process payments and manage subscriptions.

zenfox ✓ Stripe API connected.

#### Ask

Tell Zenfox which API you need — by name, by function, or by sending your API documentation. Plain language, no setup required.

#### Connect

Zenfox finds the API, handles OAuth or API key authentication, manages token exchange, and stores credentials encrypted — automatically.

#### Schema

A typed schema is auto-generated from the API spec or your docs. Endpoints, parameters, and response shapes are mapped instantly.
